title: 迦娜·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 浅金近白长发映衬尖耳，流动的蓝白衣装保留轻盈轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Janna is an adult wind spirit woman with long pale blond-white hair, pointed ears, luminous blue eyes, and flowing blue-white garments. Preserve her slender natural adult proportions and long crystal-topped staff. A fully covering long-sleeved robe with an opaque underlayer, covered legs, and shoes replaces revealing costume panels; the staff stays grounded vertically, with no active storm or attacking spell.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: silver white, pale blue, teal, warm horizon gold; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
